##### Project general facts

Levanto by ORO24 is a striking residential tower that redefines contemporary living, offering an elegant collection of studio, one, two, and three-bedroom apartments alongside spacious two and three-bedroom duplex residences. Every home is designed with meticulous attention to detail, reflecting ORO24's vision of creating a perfect abode where luxury, elegance, and fun coexist in harmony. Levanto invites residents to embrace a lifestyle where every wish comes alive under one beautiful roof, truly redefining what modern living can be.

Levanto pampers its residents with a dazzling array of world-class amenities designed for relaxation, wellness, and entertainment. Residents can unwind at the 42m mega pool, family jacuzzi, and kids' pool, stay active with an indoor golfing zone, health club, squash court, and a 260m jogging trail, or enjoy leisurely moments in the sky garden, verandah, and cabana lounges. The lifestyle offering extends further with a rooftop cinema, bowling alley, billiards room, chess arena, multimedia and gaming zone, business centers, library, and party hall, all wrapped in the sophistication of a drive-in entrance lobby and a grand, welcoming lobby experience.

Inside, every residence at Levanto embraces a refined sense of style, blending sophisticated design with everyday comfort. Thoughtfully composed living spaces flow seamlessly from room to room, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere enriched by tasteful, contemporary finishes throughout. From the elegant entrance lobby to the beautifully appointed interiors, every corner of Levanto has been crafted to deliver a truly elevated living experience for residents and their families.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Village Circle is a vibrant and rapidly growing community that captivates residents and visitors alike, offering a harmonious blend of modern living and natural beauty. The community's tree-lined streets, tranquil parks, and spacious villas and apartments create a unique and welcoming atmosphere, providing a sense of peace and balance that is hard to find in the city.

JVC's tree-lined streets, tranquil parks, and spacious villas and apartments make it a truly unique and welcoming place to call home. The community exudes a sense of peace and balance, providing a welcome escape from the hustle and bustle of city life, while still being conveniently located within Dubai.

Jumeirah Village Circle's amenities and natural beauty make it an attractive destination for families, who can enjoy the community's parks, schools, and recreational facilities. The community's central location and convenient amenities also make it an ideal choice for professionals, who can easily access the city's business districts and attractions.
